description:
Yoon-Jung, who shouldn't fall in love, falls in love with Cupid?!

Yoon-jung, who has been able to see Cupid since she was young, begins to think that 'love is a false emotion created by Cupid after her mother gets shot by Cupid's arrow and divorces due to an affair. Soon after, her father leaves home, and she dreams of a happy future with her older sister, but her older sister starts avoiding Yoon-Jung after her relationship is discovered. The person suspected of being her sister's lover is Han-Gyeol, the most popular boy in school. While watching the two, Yoon-Jung witnesses Han-Gyeol and her teacher kissing, but is suddenly chased by Cupid. Fearing that her past wounds will repeat themselves, Yoon-Jung uses the bag she was carrying to blast Cupid away, but when she comes to, the arrow is already in her chest, and she realizes belatedly that she was looking at Cupid when she was hit by the arrow. Will Yoon-Jung fall in love with Cupid...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
